38.text: “Strength? This is a celebration, not a war council.”

46.speaker: Player_Romus

896.speaker: Estela Toras
896.text: "Bravo, Mr. Montoro. You've earned yourself a seat at this table."

897.speaker: Player_Romus
897.text: "Yes, thank you, Rusty. What an unexpectedly thoughtful gift."

901.speaker: Player_Romus
901.text: "Wheeling and dealing with foreign governments behind my back is your idea of a present?"

902.speaker: Player_Romus
902.text: "Be honest, Rusty. Was your intention to celebrate the Queen Mother's birthday or diversify your own personal holdings?"

904.speaker: Player_Romus
904.text: "And where are the King's cigarettes, pray tell?"

905.speaker: Russello Montoro
905.text: "No worries. I've brought more than enough to go round."

906.speaker: Russello Montoro
906.text: "Unexpected? You wound me. I think of you and the Royal Family all the time."

907.speaker: Russello Montoro
907.text: "It's called normalizing relations. I thought you'd like it."

908.speaker: Narrator
908.text: Rusty caught my eye and threw me a wink.

916.speaker: Player_Romus
916.text: "Those are peaceful protesters, not rioters. As long as they don't enter the library, they should be free to demonstrate where they want."

917.speaker: Titus Gordion
917.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. I'll relay your instructions."

944.speaker: Player_Romus
944.text: "Ah, the adoring cries of my faithful subjects. I feel so soothed."

950.speaker: Player_Romus
950.text: "I can't believe they're still at it. Haven't they learned their lesson yet?"

952.speaker: Player_Romus
952.text: "Can't the Golden Guard deal with that ruckus?"

957.speaker: Titus Gordion
957.text: "As your security councilor, I'd advise we come up with a long-term plan to deal with these protests."

958.speaker: Titus Gordion
958.text: "If I may ask, Your Majesty... what does the Crown plan on doing about these protests in the long term?"

959.speaker: Player_Romus
959.text: "I have a plan, Titus. Place your trust in your King, and all will be well."

960.speaker: Player_Romus
960.text: "Tonight, I plan to ask the royal houses to come to my aid. With the entirety of the Rizian nobility working together, we can bring peace to the kingdom once more."

961.speaker: Player_Romus
961.text: "I've tried everything, Captain. I have no clue how to stop them."

963.speaker: Titus Gordion
963.text: "An excellent idea. I wish you luck with it."

965.speaker: Titus Gordion
965.text: "The Golden Guard is here to assist you, should you need us."

966.speaker: Player_Romus
966.text: "These ingrates have gone against their king, and they will be punished. All of them."

972.speaker: Titus Gordion
972.text: "The movement is spreading quickly, Your Majesty. I'm worried it can no longer be suppressed."

973.speaker: Player_Romus
973.text: "All these people want is reform. Sooner or later, we will have to give it to them."

975.speaker: Russello Montoro
975.text: "Looking forward to the rest of the night. I bet it'll be full of surprises."
